verdict.rationale: The evidence documents fraud-prevention building blocks: real-time card authorization decisions, 3DS, transfer approval holds, entity validations, and return correlation. Nothing in the pack says who absorbs losses from ACH return fraud, card disputes, or account takeover, so the story's central requirement (an explicit liability split documented alongside the tooling) is unevidenced. Prevention controls alone are adjacent features, not the fraud-economics disclosure the story asks for.

support.subject: As a finance lead, fraud economics are explicit — who eats ACH return fraud, card disputes, and account takeover losses, with the platform's prevention tooling documented alongside the liability split
